title: Remap shortcut not working as expected
author: tlansec

status.label: Screenshot-only remap; conflict hypothesis
status.detail: The issue includes the configured remap as an image and says it has no effect. An automated duplicate suggestion points to #45444, but that issue's closure chain does not establish coverage for this mapping.

next_action: Reproduce the exact shortcut shown in the attached image and inspect whether the Keyboard Manager shortcut-conflict ignore setting suppresses it before designing a code change.

judgment.rationale: The reporter supplies a screenshot of the configured shortcut and says it has no effect on PowerToys 0.97.1. A separate issue #45444 reports a similar ineffective remap that began working after disabling an 'Ignore shortcut' conflict option, but the automated duplicate chain does not establish that the same mapping or cause applies here. A maintainer can test the screenshot's configuration directly.
evidence: The issue reports PowerToys 0.97.1 from the Microsoft Store and includes a screenshot of the shortcut configuration.
The report says the configured shortcut has no effect but does not transcribe the source and target key combinations into text.

An automated comment suggests #45444 as a possible duplicate. In #45444, a commenter said disabling the 'Ignore shortcut' conflict option restored remaps; that issue was later closed as a duplicate of #21497, whose report concerns Caps Lock after waking from a screen saver.
The duplicate suggestion and conflict-option behavior are therefore leads to verify, not proof that this issue is covered or fixed.
judgment.recommended_action: Use the attached configuration to reproduce on a current build, check the shortcut-conflict ignore state, and only design a fix after identifying the failing condition.

fix_assessment.rationale: The reported no-op may be caused by the Keyboard Manager shortcut-conflict ignore setting, as in a related but not proven-equivalent report. The exact mapping must be reproduced before selecting a code fix.

proposed_fixes.title: Resolve a shortcut-conflict suppression if it disables this mapping
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Hypothesis: the configured shortcut is ignored because a shortcut-conflict control is enabled or stale. A commenter on possible duplicate #45444 reported that disabling 'Ignore shortcut' restored a similar remap, but the current issue's screenshot-only mapping has not been compared with that case.
plan: Read the source and target keys from the issue's existing screenshot and reproduce that exact mapping on PowerToys 0.97.1 or a current stable build.
Inspect the Keyboard Manager shortcut-conflict state and test the same mapping with the reported 'Ignore shortcut' option enabled and disabled.
If the option suppresses the mapping unexpectedly, correct the conflict-state handling or make the suppression explicit in the UI and add a regression test.
If the option is unrelated, trace the exact source/target chord through shortcut matching and update the duplicate assessment based on the observed path.
verification: The exact mapping shown in the issue screenshot either invokes its configured target or displays an explicit, accurate conflict explanation.
Changing the shortcut-conflict ignore setting has a predictable and documented effect on this mapping.
The conclusion does not rely on the automated possible-duplicate suggestion without confirming equivalent configuration and behavior.

confidence.rationale: The no-op is reported with a configuration screenshot, but the key combinations are not transcribed and the only conflict-setting lead comes from a different issue whose duplicate chain is not equivalent.

issue_context.summary: A shortcut configuration shown in an attached screenshot reportedly has no effect on PowerToys 0.97.1.
known_information: The issue reports PowerToys 0.97.1 from the Microsoft Store.
The reporter says configuring the shortcut shown in the issue image has no effect.
The issue has one automated comment suggesting #45444 as a possible duplicate.

In #45444, a commenter said disabling the 'Ignore shortcut' option in Shortcut conflicts restored a remap; #45444 was closed as a duplicate of #21497, which describes a different Caps Lock/screensaver scenario.
inferences: The shortcut-conflict ignore setting is a possible cause but has not been shown to apply to the screenshot's mapping.
The automated duplicate suggestion may be a false positive because the linked duplicate chain does not establish the same configured shortcut.
issue_context.analysis: The existing screenshot gives a maintainer a concrete configuration to test, but the report text omits the source and target key combinations. A similar conflict-option workaround exists in another issue, but it is not sufficient to classify this as a duplicate or claim that the setting is responsible. Reproduce the exact screenshot mapping and inspect the conflict state before selecting a code change.
initial_investigation: Read the live issue body, screenshot reference, label, and automated duplicate comment.
Read the proposed duplicate chain through #45444 and #21497; #21497 concerns a different Caps Lock/screensaver behavior, so the chain is not accepted as confirmed duplicate coverage.
No linked pull request or verified covering fix was found.

information_gaps.information: The exact source and target key combinations shown in the screenshot and whether the shortcut-conflict ignore option is enabled for this mapping.
information_gaps.why_needed: Those details distinguish a conflict-setting suppression from a different shortcut matching or injection failure.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Read the existing screenshot and reproduce the mapping while checking Shortcut conflicts; no new screenshot or diagnostic archive is needed.

actions.label: Approve shortcut-conflict investigation
actions.note: Treat the conflict setting as a hypothesis only; first verify the exact screenshot mapping and the duplicate chain.

actions.note: Use the existing image and compare the shortcut-conflict ignore setting; do not request the same screenshot again.

reproduce.title: Test the shortcut shown in issue 45455
reproduce.version_requirement: PowerToys 0.97.1 or newer; record the exact build
prerequisites: Access to the shortcut configuration shown in the issue attachment
setup: Configure the exact source and target shortcut shown in the issue screenshot.
steps: Trigger the configured source shortcut and record whether the target occurs.
Inspect Keyboard Manager's Shortcut conflicts view for an 'Ignore shortcut' setting affecting the mapping.
Repeat as a controlled test with that setting enabled and disabled, if it applies.
reproduce.expected_result: The configured target works when the mapping is enabled; any conflict-based suppression is explicit and changes predictably when its setting is toggled.
reproduce.setup_prompt: Open issue #45455's existing shortcut screenshot, enter the same source and target in Keyboard Manager, and compare the result with the Shortcut conflicts ignore setting enabled and disabled.
